_meta.description: Research-only price registry for FIXEO serrurerie. NOT to be imported into production. These are research reference ranges pending human calibration. All prices in MAD.
_meta.canonical_disclaimer: Prix indicatif FIXEO — tarif réel confirmé avec l'artisan avant intervention.
_meta.diagnostic_absorption: HUMAN_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED — diagnostic/call-out structural relevance to locksmith must be determined by human calibration. NOT automatically adopted from plumbing/electricity.
_meta.note_on_modifiers: Evidence strongly supports 50% night surcharge (22h–7h). This is documented as market evidence but MUST NOT be made canonical until human calibration decision is made.

services.description: Porte blindée fermée sans clé. Outillage spécifique. Ouverture non destructive tentée en premier.
services.condition: Porte blindée confirmée, non verrouillée à clé

services.label: Extraction de clé cassée
services.description: Fragment de clé dans le barillet. Outils spécialisés. Pas de remplacement si cylindre intact.
services.condition: Barillet intact après extraction. Si cylindre endommagé: cylindre_remplacement facturé séparément.

services.label: Remplacement cylindre standard
services.description: Remplacement barillet cylindre européen standard (qualité entrée/milieu de gamme). Main d'oeuvre + cylindre standard inclus. Client doit approuver la référence et le prix du cylindre avant installation.
services.note_on_range: 200 MAD = lower-bound (entry-level cylinder only, marginal artisan net). MINIMUM VIABLE price with standard cylinder (150 MAD part) is 350 MAD at 15% commission + 40 MAD fuel. 500 MAD = quality brand (Vachette, Mul-T-Lock). Human calibrator must decide reference price. Client must be informed of exact brand and price before installation.
hors_perimetre_triggers: Cylindre haute sécurité ou breveté demandé

services.label: Remplacement serrure monopoint standard
services.description: Remplacement serrure complète monopoint (porte standard). Main d'oeuvre + serrure standard incluse.

services.label: Déblocage serrure grippée
services.description: Dégrippage, lubrification, réalignement pêne. Aucun remplacement si mécanisme intact.
services.condition: Mécanisme intact, pas de remplacement nécessaire
services.note_on_floor: 100 MAD is unviable at 15% commission + 40 MAD fuel (artisan net = 45 MAD). Minimum viable price = 170 MAD (artisan net = 105 MAD). Market floor from evidence is 150 MAD — but at 150 MAD artisan net = 87 MAD, below 100 MAD floor. Human calibrator must decide: 170 MAD minimum viable, or 200 MAD for comfort.
services.note: LOW confidence — single source mention. Human must decide if this is worth a separate pilot entry.

analyses.verdict: PASS — 130 > 100 MAD floor. Duration ~15 min. Net/hour = 520 MAD/h. Viable.
analyses.verdict_worst: MARGINAL — exactly at floor. Price cannot go lower.

analyses.scenario: 15% commission, 40 MAD fuel, 150 MAD standard cylinder cost
analyses.verdict: MARGINAL — at 300 MAD the artisan net before labour is low if using standard cylinder. At 350–400 MAD more viable.
analyses.note: This is why the range 200–500 exists. 200 MAD is unsustainable without a very cheap cylinder. Human calibrator must decide reference price carefully.

artisan_floor_analysis.conclusion: No proposed FIXEO research reference price fails the artisan floor test at 15% commission and 40 MAD fuel, with the exception of cylindre_remplacement_standard at 200 MAD which is the floor (parts excluded scenario). The research reference prices are sustainable at 15% commission with the standard 40 MAD fuel scenario.

diagnostic_callout_assessment.question: Is a standalone diagnostic / call-out fee structurally relevant to Moroccan locksmith services?
reasoning: In plumbing/electricity, a diagnostic involves inspection before a recommendation. In locksmithing, the intervention type (porte claquée, clé cassée, etc.) is typically stated by the client before arrival.
The Moroccan market evidence shows locksmith pricing is INTERVENTION-BASED, not DIAGNOSTIC-BASED. The artisan states a price for 'ouverture porte claquée' over the phone.
However, for complex scenarios (blindée verrouillée, coffre fort, damage assessment), a call-out/inspection fee may be appropriate before the intervention quote.
Market sources show locksmith call-out fees are NOT common as standalone charges in Morocco — they are typically bundled into the intervention price.
Night surcharge (50%) effectively acts as an urgency fee and is already well-evidenced.
diagnostic_callout_assessment.recommendation: DO NOT automatically create a serrurerie.diagnostic fee equivalent to plomberie.diagnostic=180 MAD. Instead: (1) DIAGNOSIS_FIRST services have a 'déplacement diagnostic' cost that should be quoted before travel; (2) This should be decided by human calibration, not copied from plumbing.
